declarations.docstring: A family of six vectors with eight rational coordinates.
The integer pairing matrix of the six-vector family agrees entrywise with the given adjacency matrix.
Every member of the six-vector family lies in the indicated auxiliary set.
A family of seven vectors with eight rational coordinates.
The integer pairing matrix of the seven-vector family agrees entrywise with the given adjacency matrix.
Every member of the seven-vector family lies in the indicated auxiliary set.
A predicate on sets of eight-dimensional rational vectors encoding crystallographic root-set conditions.
A crystallographic root set contains only finitely many vectors.
The pairing of any two vectors in a crystallographic root set is an integer.
The negative of a vector in a crystallographic root set also belongs to the set.
Every vector in a crystallographic root set has self-pairing equal to two.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type is unavailable.
Reflecting one member of a crystallographic root set through another yields a member of the set.
The distinguished set of rational vectors is closed under negation.
Subtracting an integer multiple of one vector in the distinguished set from another stays in the set.
The rational-valued pairing is symmetric.
Two vectors in the distinguished set have an integer-valued rational pairing.
Reflection through a vector of self-pairing two preserves the self-pairing of every vector.
Scaling the left argument of the rational pairing scales its value by the same rational number.
Scaling the right argument of the rational pairing scales its value by the same rational number.
The rational pairing sends subtraction in its left argument to subtraction of values.
The rational pairing sends subtraction in its right argument to subtraction of values.
Reflects an eight-dimensional rational vector through another such vector.
A vector in the distinguished set remains there after reflection through a vector in the associated auxiliary set.
The auxiliary set associated with the six-vector data is closed under vector reflection.
The auxiliary set associated with the seven-vector data is closed under vector reflection.
The auxiliary set associated with the eight-vector data is closed under vector reflection.
The auxiliary set associated with the six-vector data satisfies the crystallographic root-set predicate.
The six-vector construction simultaneously has the root-set, membership, adjacency, and auxiliary matrix properties displayed in the type.
The auxiliary set associated with the seven-vector data satisfies the crystallographic root-set predicate.
The seven-vector construction simultaneously has the root-set, membership, adjacency, and auxiliary matrix properties displayed in the type.
The auxiliary set associated with the eight-vector data satisfies the crystallographic root-set predicate.
The eight-vector construction has the stated root-set, membership, matrix, and permuted adjacency properties.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type is unavailable.
Forms an integer-valued square matrix from a finite family of eight-dimensional rational vectors.
An integer-valued matrix indexed by eight row and column indices.
Each entry of the eight-indexed integer matrix casts to the pairing of the corresponding rational vectors.
Every member of the eight-vector family lies in the indicated auxiliary set.
